name: Lambertian Augmentation
definition: An augmentation that disables view-dependent radiance in the coarse NeRF to mitigate shape-radiance ambiguity and duplication artifacts caused by the NeRF varying color based on viewing direction.
summary: Lambertian Augmentation is a regularization technique that constrains an auxiliary model to view-independent colors, guiding the main radiance field toward correct geometry by mitigating shape-radiance ambiguity.
